title.de: Die TigerSquad ist offen — komm rein
title.zh: TigerSquad 开放啦 — 快加入
title.nl: De TigerSquad is open — kom erbij

body.en: The crew of makers who keep open 3D printing moving. Joining is free, takes one click, and drops 50 XP on your account straight away. Members get the perks first — and the earlier you're in, the better it looks on the wall.
body.fr: Le crew des makers qui font avancer l'impression 3D libre. C'est gratuit, ça prend un clic, et 50 XP tombent direct sur ton compte. Les membres ont les avantages en premier — et plus tu arrives tôt, mieux ça rend sur le mur.
body.de: Die Crew der Maker, die offenen 3D-Druck voranbringen. Kostenlos, ein Klick, und sofort landen 50 XP auf deinem Konto. Mitglieder bekommen die Vorteile zuerst — und wer früh dabei ist, macht an der Wand mehr her.
body.es: La banda de makers que impulsa la impresión 3D libre. Es gratis, es un clic y caen 50 XP en tu cuenta al momento. Los miembros tienen las ventajas primero — y cuanto antes llegues, mejor queda en el muro.
body.it: La crew di maker che manda avanti la stampa 3D libera. È gratis, basta un clic, e ti arrivano subito 50 XP. I membri hanno i vantaggi per primi — e prima arrivi, meglio fai figura sul muro.
body.zh: 推动开放 3D 打印的创客团队。免费加入，一键搞定，账号立刻到账 50 XP。成员优先享受福利 — 越早加入，在墙上越显眼。
body.pt: A galera de makers que faz a impressão 3D livre andar. É grátis, é um clique e 50 XP caem na hora na sua conta. Membros têm as vantagens primeiro — e quanto antes você chega, melhor fica no mural.
body.pt-pt: O grupo de makers que faz avançar a impressão 3D livre. É grátis, é um clique e caem logo 50 XP na tua conta. Os membros têm as vantagens primeiro — e quanto mais cedo chegares, melhor ficas no mural.
body.pl: Ekipa makerów, która pcha do przodu wolny druk 3D. Za darmo, jedno kliknięcie i od razu 50 XP na koncie. Członkowie dostają korzyści pierwsi — a im wcześniej wbijesz, tym lepiej wyglądasz na ścianie.
body.ru: Команда мейкеров, которая двигает открытую 3D-печать. Бесплатно, в один клик, и сразу +50 XP на аккаунт. Участники получают плюшки первыми — и чем раньше ты с нами, тем круче смотришься на стене.
body.nl: De crew van makers die open 3D-printen vooruit helpt. Gratis, één klik, en meteen 50 XP op je account. Leden krijgen de voordelen als eerste — en hoe eerder je erbij bent, hoe beter het staat op de muur.

body.en: Your level shows as a badge on your avatar, for your friends and on the public wall. Bronze the day you join, Silver at 20 TigerTag chips, Gold with a coffee, Platinum with a coffee and 50 certified TigerTag+. It climbs on its own — you just keep printing.
body.fr: Ton niveau s'affiche en badge sur ton avatar, chez tes amis et sur le mur public. Bronze le jour où tu rejoins, Silver à 20 puces TigerTag, Gold avec un café, Platinum avec un café et 50 TigerTag+ certifiées. Il grimpe tout seul — toi, tu continues d'imprimer.
body.de: Dein Level erscheint als Abzeichen an deinem Avatar, bei deinen Freunden und an der öffentlichen Wand. Bronze ab dem Beitritt, Silver ab 20 TigerTag-Chips, Gold mit einem Kaffee, Platinum mit Kaffee und 50 zertifizierten TigerTag+. Es steigt von selbst — du druckst einfach weiter.
body.es: Tu nivel aparece como insignia en tu avatar, para tus amigos y en el muro público. Bronze al unirte, Silver con 20 chips TigerTag, Gold con un café, Platinum con un café y 50 TigerTag+ certificados. Sube solo — tú sigue imprimiendo.
body.it: Il tuo livello appare come badge sull'avatar, per gli amici e sul muro pubblico. Bronze quando entri, Silver con 20 chip TigerTag, Gold con un caffè, Platinum con un caffè e 50 TigerTag+ certificati. Sale da solo — tu continua a stampare.
body.zh: 你的等级会以徽章显示在头像上，好友和公开墙都看得到。加入即 Bronze，20 个 TigerTag 芯片升 Silver，请杯咖啡升 Gold，咖啡加 50 个认证 TigerTag+ 升 Platinum。它会自己往上涨 — 你只管继续打印。
body.pt: Seu nível aparece como selo no avatar, para os amigos e no mural público. Bronze ao entrar, Silver com 20 chips TigerTag, Gold com um café, Platinum com um café e 50 TigerTag+ certificados. Ele sobe sozinho — você só continua imprimindo.
body.pt-pt: O teu nível aparece como selo no avatar, para os amigos e no mural público. Bronze ao entrares, Silver com 20 chips TigerTag, Gold com um café, Platinum com um café e 50 TigerTag+ certificados. Sobe sozinho — tu só continuas a imprimir.
body.pl: Twój poziom widać jako odznakę na awatarze, u znajomych i na publicznej ścianie. Bronze od dołączenia, Silver przy 20 chipach TigerTag, Gold z kawą, Platinum z kawą i 50 certyfikowanymi TigerTag+. Rośnie sam — ty po prostu drukuj dalej.
body.ru: Твой уровень — это значок на аватаре, у друзей и на публичной стене. Bronze при вступлении, Silver с 20 чипами TigerTag, Gold с кофе, Platinum с кофе и 50 сертифицированными TigerTag+. Растёт сам — ты просто печатай дальше.
body.nl: Je niveau staat als badge op je avatar, bij je vrienden en op de openbare muur. Bronze zodra je erbij komt, Silver bij 20 TigerTag-chips, Gold met een koffie, Platinum met een koffie en 50 gecertificeerde TigerTag+. Het stijgt vanzelf — jij print gewoon door.

title.en: XP for every chip — even the old ones
title.fr: De l'XP pour chaque puce — même les anciennes
title.de: XP für jeden Chip — auch die alten
title.es: XP por cada chip — incluso los viejos
title.it: XP per ogni chip — anche i vecchi
title.zh: 每个芯片都有 XP — 老的也算
title.pt: XP por cada chip — até os antigos
title.pt-pt: XP por cada chip — até os antigos
title.pl: XP za każdy chip — nawet stare
title.ru: XP за каждый чип — даже старые
title.nl: XP voor elke chip — ook de oude

body.en: Every TigerTag in your stock earns points: 1 for a TigerTag, 2 for a TigerTag+, 10 for a certified one. Everything already on your shelves counts from day one, and your total sits right under your name.
body.fr: Chaque TigerTag de ton stock rapporte des points : 1 pour une TigerTag, 2 pour une TigerTag+, 10 pour une certifiée. Tout ce qui est déjà sur tes étagères compte dès le premier jour, et ton total s'affiche juste sous ton nom.
body.de: Jeder TigerTag in deinem Bestand bringt Punkte: 1 für einen TigerTag, 2 für einen TigerTag+, 10 für einen zertifizierten. Alles, was schon im Regal liegt, zählt ab Tag eins, und deine Summe steht direkt unter deinem Namen.
body.es: Cada TigerTag de tu stock da puntos: 1 por un TigerTag, 2 por un TigerTag+, 10 por uno certificado. Todo lo que ya está en tus estantes cuenta desde el primer día, y tu total aparece justo bajo tu nombre.
body.it: Ogni TigerTag in magazzino porta punti: 1 per un TigerTag, 2 per un TigerTag+, 10 per uno certificato. Tutto quello che hai già sugli scaffali conta dal primo giorno, e il totale sta proprio sotto il tuo nome.
body.zh: 库存里的每个 TigerTag 都能拿分：TigerTag 1 分，TigerTag+ 2 分，认证款 10 分。架子上已有的从第一天起就算数，总分就显示在你名字下面。
body.pt: Cada TigerTag no seu estoque rende pontos: 1 por TigerTag, 2 por TigerTag+, 10 por um certificado. Tudo que já está na prateleira conta desde o primeiro dia, e o total aparece logo abaixo do seu nome.
body.pt-pt: Cada TigerTag no teu stock dá pontos: 1 por TigerTag, 2 por TigerTag+, 10 por um certificado. Tudo o que já está nas prateleiras conta desde o primeiro dia, e o total aparece mesmo por baixo do teu nome.
body.pl: Każdy TigerTag w magazynie daje punkty: 1 za TigerTag, 2 za TigerTag+, 10 za certyfikowany. Wszystko, co już leży na półkach, liczy się od pierwszego dnia, a suma wisi tuż pod twoim nickiem.
body.ru: Каждый TigerTag на складе приносит очки: 1 за TigerTag, 2 за TigerTag+, 10 за сертифицированный. Всё, что уже на полках, считается с первого дня, а сумма видна прямо под твоим именем.
body.nl: Elke TigerTag in je voorraad levert punten op: 1 voor een TigerTag, 2 voor een TigerTag+, 10 voor een gecertificeerde. Alles wat al op je planken ligt telt vanaf dag één, en je totaal staat meteen onder je naam.

title.en: Buy the project a coffee, your way
title.fr: Offre un café au projet, à ta façon
title.de: Spendier dem Projekt einen Kaffee, wie du willst
title.es: Invita un café al proyecto, a tu manera
title.it: Offri un caffè al progetto, come preferisci
title.zh: 按你的方式请项目喝杯咖啡
title.pt: Pague um café pro projeto, do seu jeito
title.pt-pt: Oferece um café ao projeto, à tua maneira
title.nl: Trakteer het project op koffie, op jouw manier

body.en: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi or PayPal — pick the one you like. The app stays free and open source either way; a coffee just links to your account and lifts you to Gold once you're in the TigerSquad.
body.fr: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi ou PayPal — choisis celui qui te va. L'app reste gratuite et open source quoi qu'il arrive ; un café se rattache simplement à ton compte et te fait passer Gold une fois dans la TigerSquad.
body.de: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi oder PayPal — such dir eins aus. Die App bleibt so oder so kostenlos und Open Source; ein Kaffee wird einfach deinem Konto zugeordnet und macht dich Gold, sobald du in der TigerSquad bist.
body.es: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi o PayPal — elige el que prefieras. La app sigue gratis y open source pase lo que pase; un café se vincula a tu cuenta y te sube a Gold cuando estás en la TigerSquad.
body.it: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi o PayPal — scegli quello che ti piace. L'app resta gratis e open source in ogni caso; un caffè si collega al tuo account e ti porta a Gold una volta nella TigerSquad.
body.zh: Buy Me a Coffee、Ko-fi 或 PayPal — 挑你顺手的。应用始终免费开源；一杯咖啡会关联到你的账号，加入 TigerSquad 后直接升 Gold。
body.pt: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi ou PayPal — escolha o que preferir. O app continua grátis e open source de qualquer jeito; um café só fica ligado à sua conta e te leva a Gold quando você está na TigerSquad.
body.pt-pt: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi ou PayPal — escolhe o que preferires. A app continua grátis e open source de qualquer forma; um café fica ligado à tua conta e leva-te a Gold quando estás na TigerSquad.
body.pl: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi albo PayPal — wybierz, co ci pasuje. Aplikacja i tak zostaje darmowa i open source; kawa po prostu przypisuje się do twojego konta i daje ci Gold, gdy jesteś w TigerSquad.
body.ru: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi или PayPal — выбирай, что нравится. Приложение в любом случае остаётся бесплатным и открытым; кофе просто привязывается к аккаунту и поднимает тебя до Gold, когда ты в TigerSquad.
body.nl: Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi of PayPal — kies wat je wilt. De app blijft hoe dan ook gratis en open source; een koffie wordt gewoon aan je account gekoppeld en maakt je Gold zodra je in de TigerSquad zit.

title.fr: Les recharges, repérées d'un coup d'œil

body.en: Spools that come without their own reel now wear a green Refill tag on their picture — in the grid, the lists, the spool details and the catalogue product card. No more opening each one to check.
body.fr: Les bobines livrées sans flasque portent maintenant une étiquette verte Refill sur leur photo — dans la grille, les listes, le détail de la bobine et la fiche produit du catalogue. Fini d'ouvrir chaque bobine pour vérifier.
body.de: Spulen ohne eigene Rolle tragen jetzt ein grünes Refill-Etikett auf ihrem Bild — im Raster, in den Listen, in den Spulendetails und auf der Produktkarte im Katalog. Kein Durchklicken mehr zum Nachschauen.
body.es: Las bobinas que llegan sin carrete propio llevan ahora una etiqueta verde Refill en su foto — en la cuadrícula, las listas, el detalle de la bobina y la ficha del catálogo. Se acabó abrir cada una para mirar.
body.it: Le bobine senza rocchetto proprio ora hanno un'etichetta verde Refill sulla foto — nella griglia, nelle liste, nel dettaglio della bobina e nella scheda del catalogo. Basta aprirle una a una per controllare.
body.zh: 没有自带线盘的耗材现在会在图片上显示绿色 Refill 标签 — 网格、列表、耗材详情和目录商品卡都有。不用再一个个点开确认了。
body.pt: Bobinas que vêm sem carretel próprio agora têm uma etiqueta verde Refill na foto — na grade, nas listas, no detalhe da bobina e na ficha do catálogo. Chega de abrir uma por uma pra conferir.
body.pt-pt: As bobinas que vêm sem carretel próprio têm agora uma etiqueta verde Refill na foto — na grelha, nas listas, no detalhe da bobina e na ficha do catálogo. Acabou abrir uma a uma para confirmar.
body.pl: Szpule bez własnej szpulki mają teraz zieloną plakietkę Refill na zdjęciu — w siatce, na listach, w szczegółach szpuli i na karcie produktu w katalogu. Koniec z otwieraniem każdej po kolei.
body.ru: Катушки без собственной бобины теперь носят зелёную метку Refill на фото — в сетке, списках, деталях катушки и карточке товара в каталоге. Больше не нужно открывать каждую.
body.nl: Spoelen zonder eigen haspel dragen nu een groen Refill-label op hun foto — in het raster, de lijsten, de spoeldetails en de productkaart in de catalogus. Niet meer elke spoel openen om te checken.

title.fr: On t'a répondu ? Tu le sais
title.de: Wir haben geantwortet? Du erfährst es
title.pt: A gente respondeu? Você fica sabendo
title.nl: Hebben we gereageerd? Je weet het

body.en: When the team replies to one of your requests, a notification pops up and takes you straight to it. Your own comments don't ping you — only the answers you were waiting for.
body.fr: Quand l'équipe répond à une de tes demandes, une notification apparaît et t'y emmène direct. Tes propres commentaires ne te notifient pas — seulement les réponses que tu attendais.
body.de: Wenn das Team auf eine deiner Anfragen antwortet, erscheint eine Benachrichtigung und bringt dich direkt hin. Deine eigenen Kommentare melden sich nicht — nur die Antworten, auf die du gewartet hast.
body.es: Cuando el equipo responde a una de tus solicitudes, salta una notificación que te lleva directo a ella. Tus propios comentarios no te avisan — solo las respuestas que esperabas.
body.it: Quando il team risponde a una tua richiesta, compare una notifica che ti porta dritto lì. I tuoi commenti non ti notificano — solo le risposte che aspettavi.
body.zh: 团队回复你的请求时，会弹出通知并直接带你过去。你自己的评论不会提醒你 — 只提醒你在等的回复。
body.pt: Quando a equipe responde a um pedido seu, aparece uma notificação que te leva direto pra ele. Seus próprios comentários não te avisam — só as respostas que você esperava.
body.pt-pt: Quando a equipa responde a um pedido teu, aparece uma notificação que te leva direto a ele. Os teus próprios comentários não te avisam — só as respostas que esperavas.
body.pl: Gdy zespół odpowie na twoje zgłoszenie, wyskoczy powiadomienie i zabierze cię prosto do niego. Twoje własne komentarze cię nie zaczepiają — tylko odpowiedzi, na które czekasz.
body.ru: Когда команда отвечает на твой запрос, всплывает уведомление и ведёт прямо к нему. Твои собственные комментарии не беспокоят — только ответы, которых ты ждал.
body.nl: Als het team op een van je verzoeken reageert, verschijnt er een melding die je er direct naartoe brengt. Je eigen reacties pingen je niet — alleen de antwoorden waar je op wachtte.

body.en: On some PCs every click took an eternity. The app was busy looking for a USB scale nobody had plugged in — it now does that quietly in the background, and your clicks answer right away.
body.fr: Sur certains PC, chaque clic prenait une éternité. L'app passait son temps à chercher une balance USB que personne n'avait branchée — elle le fait maintenant discrètement en coulisses, et tes clics répondent tout de suite.
body.de: Auf manchen PCs dauerte jeder Klick eine Ewigkeit. Die App suchte ständig nach einer USB-Waage, die niemand angeschlossen hatte — jetzt macht sie das leise im Hintergrund, und deine Klicks reagieren sofort.
body.es: En algunos PC cada clic tardaba una eternidad. La app se pasaba el rato buscando una báscula USB que nadie había enchufado — ahora lo hace discretamente en segundo plano y tus clics responden al momento.
body.it: Su alcuni PC ogni clic durava un'eternità. L'app passava il tempo a cercare una bilancia USB che nessuno aveva collegato — ora lo fa in silenzio dietro le quinte, e i tuoi clic rispondono subito.
body.zh: 在部分电脑上，每次点击都要等很久。应用一直在找一台根本没插上的 USB 秤——现在它会在后台悄悄找，你的点击立刻有反应。
body.pt: Em alguns PCs cada clique levava uma eternidade. O app vivia procurando uma balança USB que ninguém tinha plugado — agora faz isso quietinho nos bastidores, e seus cliques respondem na hora.
body.pt-pt: Nalguns PCs cada clique demorava uma eternidade. A app passava a vida à procura de uma balança USB que ninguém tinha ligado — agora fá-lo discretamente nos bastidores, e os teus cliques respondem logo.
body.pl: Na niektórych PC każde kliknięcie trwało wieczność. Aplikacja ciągle szukała wagi USB, której nikt nie podłączył — teraz robi to po cichu w tle, a twoje kliknięcia działają od razu.
body.ru: На некоторых ПК каждый клик длился вечность. Приложение всё искало USB-весы, которые никто не подключал, — теперь делает это тихо в фоне, и клики срабатывают сразу.
body.nl: Op sommige pc's duurde elke klik een eeuwigheid. De app zocht de hele tijd naar een USB-weegschaal die niemand had aangesloten — nu doet hij dat stilletjes op de achtergrond en reageren je klikken meteen.

body.en: Signing in with Google could stall on a "fetch failed" on some computers. It now goes through the same road as your browser, so if Google opens in your browser, it opens in the app too.
body.fr: La connexion avec Google pouvait caler sur un « fetch failed » sur certains ordis. Elle passe maintenant par le même chemin que ton navigateur : si Google s'ouvre dans ton navigateur, il s'ouvre dans l'app aussi.
body.de: Die Anmeldung mit Google konnte auf manchen Rechnern an einem „fetch failed“ hängen bleiben. Jetzt nimmt sie denselben Weg wie dein Browser — wenn Google dort aufgeht, klappt's auch in der App.
body.es: El inicio de sesión con Google podía atascarse en un «fetch failed» en algunos ordenadores. Ahora va por el mismo camino que tu navegador: si Google abre ahí, abre también en la app.
body.it: L'accesso con Google poteva bloccarsi su un «fetch failed» su alcuni computer. Ora passa dalla stessa strada del tuo browser: se Google si apre lì, si apre anche nell'app.
body.zh: 在部分电脑上，用 Google 登录可能卡在 “fetch failed”。现在它走和浏览器同一条路：浏览器里能打开 Google，应用里也能。
body.pt: O login com Google podia travar num "fetch failed" em alguns computadores. Agora ele vai pelo mesmo caminho do seu navegador: se o Google abre lá, abre no app também.
body.pt-pt: O início de sessão com o Google podia encravar num "fetch failed" nalguns computadores. Agora vai pelo mesmo caminho do teu navegador: se o Google abre lá, abre na app também.
body.pl: Logowanie przez Google mogło utknąć na „fetch failed” na niektórych komputerach. Teraz idzie tą samą drogą co przeglądarka: jeśli Google działa tam, zadziała też w aplikacji.
body.ru: Вход через Google мог застрять на «fetch failed» на некоторых компьютерах. Теперь он идёт тем же путём, что и браузер: открывается Google там — откроется и в приложении.
body.nl: Inloggen met Google kon op sommige computers vastlopen op "fetch failed". Nu neemt het dezelfde weg als je browser: opent Google daar, dan ook in de app.

title.it: La tua IA conosce il tuo scaffale
title.zh: 你的 AI 认识你的料架
title.pt-pt: A tua IA conhece a tua prateleira

body.en: Hook up Claude, Cursor or VS Code in one click from My profile and just ask: "what PLA am I running low on?". It can look at your spools, racks, printers and your friends' shared stock — look, never touch.
body.fr: Branche Claude, Cursor ou VS Code en un clic depuis Mon profil et demande-lui simplement : « il me reste quoi en PLA ? ». Il voit tes bobines, tes racks, tes imprimantes et le stock partagé de tes potes — il regarde, il ne touche à rien.
body.de: Verbinde Claude, Cursor oder VS Code mit einem Klick unter Mein Profil und frag einfach: „Wovon hab ich kaum noch PLA?“. Er sieht Spulen, Regale, Drucker und den geteilten Bestand deiner Freunde — schauen ja, anfassen nie.
body.es: Conecta Claude, Cursor o VS Code en un clic desde Mi perfil y pregunta sin más: «¿qué PLA se me está acabando?». Ve tus bobinas, racks, impresoras y el stock compartido de tus amigos — mira, nunca toca.
body.it: Collega Claude, Cursor o VS Code con un clic da Il mio profilo e chiedi e basta: «che PLA sto finendo?». Vede bobine, rack, stampanti e lo stock condiviso dei tuoi amici — guarda, non tocca mai.
body.zh: 在「我的资料」里一键连接 Claude、Cursor 或 VS Code，然后直接问：“我哪种 PLA 快用完了？”它能看到你的线材、料架、打印机和好友共享的库存——只看，从不动手。
body.pt: Conecte Claude, Cursor ou VS Code com um clique em Meu perfil e é só perguntar: "qual PLA está acabando?". Ele vê seus carretéis, racks, impressoras e o estoque compartilhado dos amigos — olha, nunca mexe.
body.pt-pt: Liga o Claude, o Cursor ou o VS Code com um clique em O meu perfil e pergunta só: "que PLA está a acabar?". Ele vê as tuas bobinas, racks, impressoras e o stock partilhado dos amigos — olha, nunca mexe.
body.pl: Podłącz Claude, Cursor lub VS Code jednym kliknięciem w Mój profil i po prostu zapytaj: „jakiego PLA mi brakuje?”. Widzi szpule, regały, drukarki i udostępniony zapas znajomych — patrzy, niczego nie rusza.
body.ru: Подключи Claude, Cursor или VS Code в один клик в «Мой профиль» и просто спроси: «какой PLA у меня заканчивается?». Он видит катушки, стеллажи, принтеры и общий запас друзей — смотрит, но ничего не трогает.
body.nl: Koppel Claude, Cursor of VS Code met één klik in Mijn profiel en vraag gewoon: "welke PLA raakt op?". Hij ziet je spoelen, rekken, printers en de gedeelde voorraad van je vrienden — kijken mag, aankomen nooit.

title.es: Windows se despierta a su hora

body.en: On some PCs the app used to stare at you from a black window before waking up. Not anymore — it opens straight away, and updates install like they should.
body.fr: Sur certains PC, l'app te fixait depuis une fenêtre noire avant de daigner se réveiller. C'est fini — elle s'ouvre direct, et les mises à jour s'installent comme il faut.
body.de: Auf manchen PCs starrte dich die App erst aus einem schwarzen Fenster an, bevor sie aufwachte. Vorbei — sie öffnet sofort, und Updates installieren sich, wie sie sollen.
body.es: En algunos PC la app te miraba desde una ventana negra antes de dignarse a despertar. Se acabó: abre al instante y las actualizaciones se instalan como deben.
body.it: Su alcuni PC l'app ti fissava da una finestra nera prima di degnarsi di svegliarsi. Finito — si apre subito, e gli aggiornamenti si installano come si deve.
body.zh: 在部分电脑上，应用会先用黑窗口盯着你半天才醒。现在不会了——一点就开，更新也能正常安装。
body.pt: Em alguns PCs o app ficava te encarando numa janela preta antes de acordar. Acabou — abre na hora, e as atualizações instalam direitinho.
body.pt-pt: Nalguns PCs a app ficava a olhar para ti numa janela preta antes de acordar. Acabou — abre logo, e as atualizações instalam-se como deve ser.
body.pl: Na niektórych PC aplikacja gapiła się na ciebie z czarnego okna, zanim raczyła się obudzić. Koniec — otwiera się od razu, a aktualizacje instalują się jak należy.
body.ru: На некоторых ПК приложение сначала пялилось на тебя из чёрного окна. Больше нет — открывается сразу, а обновления ставятся как положено.
body.nl: Op sommige pc's staarde de app je eerst aan vanuit een zwart venster. Niet meer — hij opent meteen, en updates installeren zoals het hoort.

title.de: Genau da, wo du sie gelassen hast
title.ru: Ровно там, где ты его оставил

body.en: The window comes back at the size and spot you left it, and opens full-size the very first time. No more dragging corners every morning.
body.fr: La fenêtre revient à la taille et à l'endroit où tu l'as laissée, et s'ouvre en grand la toute première fois. Fini de tirer les coins chaque matin.
body.de: Das Fenster kommt in der Größe und an der Stelle zurück, wo du es gelassen hast — und startet beim ersten Mal gleich groß. Kein morgendliches Ecken-Ziehen mehr.
body.es: La ventana vuelve con el tamaño y en el sitio donde la dejaste, y la primera vez se abre a lo grande. Se acabó estirar esquinas cada mañana.
body.it: La finestra torna della misura e nel punto in cui l'avevi lasciata, e la prima volta si apre a tutto schermo. Basta tirare angoli ogni mattina.
body.zh: 窗口会以你上次的大小和位置回来，第一次打开就是全尺寸。再也不用每天早上拖边角了。
body.pt: A janela volta no tamanho e no lugar onde você deixou, e abre grandona logo na primeira vez. Chega de puxar cantinho toda manhã.
body.pt-pt: A janela volta com o tamanho e no sítio onde a deixaste, e abre em grande logo da primeira vez. Acabou puxar cantos todas as manhãs.
body.pl: Okno wraca w rozmiarze i miejscu, w którym je zostawiłeś, a za pierwszym razem otwiera się na cały ekran. Koniec z ciąganiem rogów co rano.
body.ru: Окно возвращается того же размера и на то же место, а в самый первый раз открывается во весь экран. Больше никаких утренних растягиваний.
body.nl: Het venster komt terug op de grootte en plek waar je het liet, en opent de allereerste keer meteen groot. Geen hoeken meer trekken elke ochtend.

title.fr: Les nouvelles imprimantes trouvent leur place
title.es: Las impresoras nuevas encuentran su sitio
title.pt-pt: As impressoras novas encontram o seu lugar

body.en: Add a printer and it lands in the first free spot on your board, widgets neatly underneath — no more hiding at the bottom or sitting on its neighbours.
body.fr: Ajoute une imprimante et elle se pose à la première place libre de ton plan, ses widgets bien rangés dessous — fini de se planquer tout en bas ou de s'asseoir sur les voisines.
body.de: Füg einen Drucker hinzu und er landet auf dem ersten freien Platz deiner Übersicht, Widgets ordentlich darunter — kein Verstecken ganz unten, kein Draufsitzen auf den Nachbarn.
body.es: Añade una impresora y aterriza en el primer hueco libre de tu tablero, con sus widgets bien colocados debajo — nada de esconderse abajo del todo ni sentarse encima de las vecinas.
body.it: Aggiungi una stampante e atterra nel primo posto libero della tua bacheca, widget in ordine sotto — niente più nascondigli in fondo o sedute sulle vicine.
body.zh: 添加打印机后，它会落在面板上第一个空位，小组件整齐排在下面——不再躲到最底下，也不再压在邻居身上。
body.pt: Adicione uma impressora e ela pousa no primeiro espaço livre do seu painel, widgets arrumadinhos embaixo — nada de se esconder lá no fundo ou sentar em cima das vizinhas.
body.pt-pt: Adiciona uma impressora e ela pousa no primeiro lugar livre do teu painel, widgets arrumados por baixo — nada de se esconder lá em baixo ou de se sentar em cima das vizinhas.
body.pl: Dodaj drukarkę, a wyląduje na pierwszym wolnym miejscu tablicy, widżety grzecznie pod nią — koniec chowania się na samym dole i siadania na sąsiadkach.
body.ru: Добавь принтер — и он встанет на первое свободное место на доске, виджеты аккуратно под ним. Больше не прячется в самом низу и не садится на соседей.
body.nl: Voeg een printer toe en hij landt op de eerste vrije plek van je bord, widgets netjes eronder — niet meer verstoppen onderaan of op de buren zitten.

title.es: Marcos de color por todas partes
title.pt-pt: Molduras de cor por todo o lado

body.en: Your cart, lists and wishlists now frame each photo in the product's own colour — two-tones included — just like the grid. One glance, you know which spool it is.
body.fr: Ton panier, tes listes et tes envies encadrent maintenant chaque photo de la couleur du produit — bicolores compris — comme dans la grille. Un coup d'œil, tu sais quelle bobine c'est.
body.de: Warenkorb, Listen und Wunschlisten rahmen jedes Foto jetzt in der Farbe des Produkts — Zweifarbige inklusive — genau wie das Raster. Ein Blick, und du weißt, welche Spule es ist.
body.es: Tu carrito, tus listas y tus deseos enmarcan ahora cada foto con el color del producto — bicolores incluidos — igual que la cuadrícula. Un vistazo y sabes qué bobina es.
body.it: Carrello, liste e desideri ora incorniciano ogni foto col colore del prodotto — bicolori compresi — proprio come la griglia. Un'occhiata e sai che bobina è.
body.zh: 购物车、清单和心愿单现在会用产品本身的颜色给每张照片加框——双色也算——和网格一样。看一眼就知道是哪卷。
body.pt: Carrinho, listas e desejos agora emolduram cada foto na cor do produto — bicolores inclusive — igualzinho à grade. Bateu o olho, sabe qual carretel é.
body.pt-pt: O carrinho, as listas e os desejos emolduram agora cada foto na cor do produto — bicolores incluídos — tal como a grelha. Um olhar e sabes qual é a bobina.
body.pl: Koszyk, listy i listy życzeń oprawiają teraz każde zdjęcie w kolor produktu — dwukolorowe też — tak jak siatka. Jedno spojrzenie i wiesz, która to szpula.
body.ru: Корзина, списки и вишлисты теперь обрамляют каждое фото цветом самого товара — двухцветные тоже — как в сетке. Один взгляд — и ясно, что за катушка.
body.nl: Je winkelwagen, lijsten en verlanglijsten omlijsten elke foto nu in de kleur van het product — tweekleurig inbegrepen — net als het raster. Eén blik en je weet welke spoel het is.

title.zh: 长得一样的线材，叠得整整齐齐

body.en: Identical spools now stack into one tidy deck in Grid too. Tap a stack to see every spool inside, with a quick overview up top.
body.fr: Les bobines identiques s'empilent désormais en une pile bien rangée, même en Grille. Touchez une pile pour voir chaque bobine, avec un aperçu rapide en haut.
body.de: Identische Spulen stapeln sich jetzt auch in der Rasteransicht zu einem ordentlichen Deck. Tippe auf einen Stapel, um jede Spule zu sehen — mit Kurzüberblick oben.
body.es: Las bobinas idénticas ahora se apilan en un mazo ordenado también en la cuadrícula. Toca un montón para ver cada bobina, con un resumen rápido arriba.
body.it: Le bobine identiche ora si impilano in un bel mazzo anche nella griglia. Tocca una pila per vedere ogni bobina, con un riepilogo veloce in alto.
body.zh: 一模一样的线材现在在网格里也会叠成一摞。点一摞就能看到里面的每卷，上方还有快速总览。
body.pt: Bobinas idênticas agora se empilham num baralho arrumado também na grade. Toque numa pilha para ver cada bobina, com um resumo rápido no topo.
body.pt-pt: Bobinas idênticas agora empilham-se num baralho arrumado também na grelha. Toque numa pilha para ver cada bobina, com um resumo rápido no topo.
body.pl: Identyczne szpule układają się teraz w równy stosik także w widoku siatki. Dotknij stosu, by zobaczyć każdą szpulę, z szybkim podglądem na górze.

title.it: La tua scorta, a colpo d'occhio
title.pl: Twój zapas na pierwszy rzut oka

body.en: Each stack shows a little speedo gauge of filament left, plus the combined weight and count — and it all ticks up live as you reweigh a spool.
body.fr: Chaque pile affiche un petit compteur de filament restant, le poids cumulé et le nombre — et tout bouge en direct quand vous repesez une bobine.
body.de: Jeder Stapel zeigt eine kleine Tacho-Anzeige des Rest-Filaments plus Gesamtgewicht und Anzahl — und alles tickt live mit, wenn du eine Spule neu wiegst.
body.es: Cada montón muestra un cuentakilómetros del filamento que queda, más el peso total y el recuento — y todo se actualiza en vivo al repesar una bobina.
body.it: Ogni pila mostra un tachimetro del filamento rimasto, più peso totale e numero — e tutto si aggiorna in tempo reale quando ripesi una bobina.
body.zh: 每一摞都有个小仪表盘显示剩余线材，还有合计重量和数量——重新称一卷，数字就实时跳动。
body.pt: Cada pilha mostra um velocímetro do filamento restante, mais o peso total e a contagem — e tudo sobe ao vivo quando você repesa uma bobina.
body.pt-pt: Cada pilha mostra um velocímetro do filamento restante, mais o peso total e a contagem — e tudo sobe ao vivo quando repesa uma bobina.
body.pl: Każdy stos pokazuje mały wskaźnik pozostałego filamentu, łączną wagę i liczbę — a wszystko zmienia się na żywo, gdy przeważysz szpulę.

title.es: Un toque y todo se recoge
title.it: Una pressione e si chiude tutto
title.pt: Um toque e tudo se recolhe
title.pt-pt: Um toque e tudo se recolhe

body.en: Press and hold a panel's close handle for half a second and every open card folds away at once. Oddly satisfying.
body.fr: Maintenez la poignée de fermeture d'un panneau une demi-seconde et toutes les cartes ouvertes se replient d'un coup. Étonnamment satisfaisant.
body.de: Halte den Schließgriff eines Panels eine halbe Sekunde und alle offenen Karten klappen auf einen Schlag zu. Seltsam befriedigend.
body.es: Mantén pulsado el tirador de cierre de un panel medio segundo y todas las tarjetas abiertas se recogen de golpe. Curiosamente satisfactorio.
body.it: Tieni premuta la maniglia di chiusura di un pannello per mezzo secondo e tutte le schede aperte si richiudono in un colpo. Stranamente soddisfacente.
body.zh: 按住某个面板的关闭把手半秒，所有打开的卡片就会一下子全部收起。莫名地解压。
body.pt: Segure a alça de fechar de um painel por meio segundo e todos os cartões abertos se recolhem de uma vez. Estranhamente satisfatório.
body.pt-pt: Segure a pega de fechar de um painel por meio segundo e todos os cartões abertos recolhem-se de uma vez. Estranhamente satisfatório.
body.pl: Przytrzymaj uchwyt zamykania panelu przez pół sekundy, a wszystkie otwarte karty zwiną się naraz. Dziwnie satysfakcjonujące.

title.fr: Le récap de ce qui change

body.en: After every update, a little window pops in to tell you what changed — in plain words, no tech-speak. Drag it, resize it, and flip back through past versions whenever the mood strikes.
body.fr: À chaque mise à jour, une petite fenêtre vient vous raconter ce qui a changé — en clair, sans charabia. Déplacez-la, redimensionnez-la, et feuilletez les versions passées quand l'envie vous prend.
body.de: Nach jedem Update erzählt dir ein kleines Fenster, was sich getan hat — in Klartext, ohne Fachchinesisch. Verschieben, vergrößern und durch alte Versionen blättern, ganz wie du magst.
body.es: Tras cada actualización, una ventanita te cuenta qué ha cambiado — en cristiano, sin tecnicismos. Muévela, cámbiale el tamaño y curiosea versiones anteriores cuando te apetezca.
body.it: Dopo ogni aggiornamento, una finestrella ti racconta cosa è cambiato — in parole semplici, niente tecnicismi. Spostala, ridimensionala e sfoglia le versioni passate quando ti va.
body.zh: 每次更新后，一个小窗口会用大白话告诉你都改了什么。可以拖动、缩放，还能随时翻看以前的版本。
body.pt: A cada atualização, uma janelinha conta o que mudou — em bom português, sem tecniquês. Arraste, redimensione e folheie versões antigas quando bater a curiosidade.
body.pt-pt: A cada atualização, uma janelinha conta o que mudou — em bom português, sem tecniquês. Arraste, redimensione e folheie versões antigas quando lhe apetecer.
body.pl: Po każdej aktualizacji okienko po ludzku opowie, co się zmieniło. Przesuwaj je, zmieniaj rozmiar i przeglądaj starsze wersje, kiedy masz ochotę.

body.en: We gave the whole app a little glow-up — crisper icons, tidier corners, the works. Same studio, just dressed a bit smarter.
body.fr: On a offert un petit relooking à toute l'app — icônes plus nettes, coins rangés, et tout le tralala. Même studio, juste un peu mieux habillé.
body.de: Die ganze App hat ein kleines Makeover bekommen — knackigere Symbole, aufgeräumte Ecken, das volle Programm. Gleiches Studio, nur schicker angezogen.
body.es: Le hemos dado un lavado de cara a toda la app — iconos más nítidos, esquinas ordenadas y todo lo demás. El mismo estudio, mejor vestido.
body.it: Abbiamo dato una rinfrescata a tutta l'app — icone più nitide, angoli in ordine e compagnia bella. Stesso studio, vestito un po' meglio.
body.zh: 我们给整个应用做了点微整形——图标更清晰，边角更整洁，全都焕然一新。还是那个工作室，只是穿得更体面了。
body.pt: Demos um trato na app inteira — ícones mais nítidos, cantos arrumados e tudo mais. Mesmo estúdio, só que mais bem-vestido.
body.pt-pt: Demos um trato a toda a app — ícones mais nítidos, cantos arrumados e tudo o resto. Mesmo estúdio, só que mais bem-vestido.
body.pl: Cała aplikacja dostała mały lifting — wyraźniejsze ikony, uporządkowane rogi i cała reszta. To samo studio, tylko lepiej ubrane.

title.fr: Les bobines cloud rejoignent la fête
title.es: Las bobinas cloud se unen a la fiesta
title.it: Le bobine cloud si uniscono alla festa
title.pt: As bobinas na nuvem entram na festa
title.pt-pt: As bobinas na nuvem entram na festa
title.pl: Szpule z chmury dołączają do zabawy

body.en: A cloud spool and its Maker twin of the same filament now huddle into the same group instead of sulking in a corner on their own.
body.fr: Une bobine cloud et sa jumelle Maker du même filament se regroupent désormais ensemble, au lieu de bouder chacune dans son coin.
body.de: Eine Cloud-Spule und ihr Maker-Zwilling aus demselben Filament kuscheln sich jetzt in dieselbe Gruppe, statt allein in der Ecke zu schmollen.
body.es: Una bobina cloud y su gemela Maker del mismo filamento ahora se juntan en el mismo grupo, en vez de enfurruñarse cada una por su lado.
body.it: Una bobina cloud e la sua gemella Maker dello stesso filamento ora si raggruppano insieme, invece di restare imbronciate ognuna per conto suo.
body.zh: 同一种线材的云端卷和它的 Maker 双胞胎现在会凑成一组，不再各自在角落里赌气了。
body.pt: Uma bobina na nuvem e a gêmea Maker do mesmo filamento agora ficam no mesmo grupo, em vez de cada uma emburrar no seu canto.
body.pt-pt: Uma bobina na nuvem e a gémea Maker do mesmo filamento agora ficam no mesmo grupo, em vez de cada uma amuar no seu canto.
body.pl: Szpula z chmury i jej bliźniaczka Maker z tego samego filamentu trzymają się teraz razem w jednej grupie, zamiast dąsać się osobno w kącie.

body.en: The colour & TD window was glued in place. Now you can grab it and drag it wherever it suits you.
body.fr: La fenêtre couleur & TD était scotchée. Maintenant, attrapez-la et posez-la où ça vous arrange.
body.de: Das Farb- & TD-Fenster klebte fest. Jetzt schnappst du es dir und ziehst es dorthin, wo es dir passt.
body.es: La ventana de color y TD estaba pegada en su sitio. Ahora la agarras y la pones donde te venga bien.
body.it: La finestra colore e TD era incollata. Ora la afferri e la trascini dove ti pare.
body.zh: 颜色和 TD 窗口以前是钉死的。现在你可以拎起来，想放哪儿就放哪儿。
body.pt: A janela de cor e TD ficava grudada. Agora é só agarrar e arrastar para onde quiser.
body.pt-pt: A janela de cor e TD ficava colada. Agora é só agarrar e arrastar para onde quiser.
body.pl: Okno koloru i TD było przyklejone. Teraz złap je i przeciągnij, gdzie ci pasuje.

body.en: The inventory table can now fold identical spools into one expandable line with a count badge — a full shelf reads at a glance. Toggle it with the switch in the toolbar.
body.fr: Le tableau d'inventaire peut désormais regrouper les bobines identiques en une seule ligne dépliable avec un compteur — une étagère entière se lit d'un coup d'œil. Activez-le via l'interrupteur de la barre d'outils.
body.de: Die Bestandstabelle kann identische Spulen jetzt zu einer aufklappbaren Zeile mit Zähler zusammenfassen — ein ganzes Regal auf einen Blick. Über den Schalter in der Symbolleiste umschaltbar.
body.es: La tabla de inventario ahora agrupa las bobinas idénticas en una sola línea desplegable con un contador: un estante entero de un vistazo. Actívalo con el interruptor de la barra de herramientas.
body.it: La tabella dell'inventario può ora raggruppare le bobine identiche in un'unica riga espandibile con un contatore: un intero scaffale a colpo d'occhio. Attivalo dall'interruttore nella barra degli strumenti.
body.zh: 库存表格现在可将相同线轴合并为一行（带数量徽章），可展开查看——整架线轴一目了然。通过工具栏的开关切换。
body.pt: A tabela de inventário agora agrupa bobinas idênticas numa única linha expansível com um contador — uma prateleira inteira num relance. Ative pelo interruptor na barra de ferramentas.
body.pt-pt: A tabela de inventário passa a agrupar bobinas idênticas numa única linha expansível com um contador — uma prateleira inteira num relance. Ative no interruptor da barra de ferramentas.
body.pl: Tabela inwentarza może teraz zwijać identyczne szpule w jeden rozwijalny wiersz z licznikiem — cała półka na pierwszy rzut oka. Przełącz to przełącznikiem na pasku narzędzi.

body.en: The remaining-filament bar now turns red, orange or green depending on how much is left — matching the mobile app.
body.fr: La barre de filament restant passe au rouge, orange ou vert selon la quantité restante — comme dans l'app mobile.
body.de: Der Balken für das verbleibende Filament wird je nach Restmenge rot, orange oder grün — wie in der mobilen App.
body.es: La barra de filamento restante se vuelve roja, naranja o verde según lo que queda, igual que en la app móvil.
body.it: La barra del filamento residuo diventa rossa, arancione o verde in base a quanto resta — come nell'app mobile.
body.zh: 余量条会根据剩余量变为红色、橙色或绿色——与手机 App 一致。
body.pt: A barra de filamento restante fica vermelha, laranja ou verde conforme o que resta — igual à app móvel.
body.pt-pt: A barra de filamento restante fica vermelha, laranja ou verde consoante o que resta — tal como na aplicação móvel.
body.pl: Pasek pozostałego filamentu zmienia kolor na czerwony, pomarańczowy lub zielony zależnie od ilości — tak jak w aplikacji mobilnej.

title.zh: 更智能的"从 API 刷新"

body.en: Refreshing a TigerTag+ spool now also corrects its brand, material, finish, temperatures and colour from the catalogue. If the chip needs rewriting, the spool is flagged.
body.fr: Actualiser une bobine TigerTag+ corrige aussi sa marque, sa matière, son aspect, ses températures et sa couleur depuis le catalogue. Si la puce doit être réécrite, la bobine est signalée.
body.de: Beim Aktualisieren einer TigerTag+-Spule werden jetzt auch Marke, Material, Oberfläche, Temperaturen und Farbe aus dem Katalog korrigiert. Muss der Chip neu beschrieben werden, wird die Spule markiert.
body.es: Actualizar una bobina TigerTag+ ahora también corrige su marca, material, acabado, temperaturas y color desde el catálogo. Si hay que reescribir el chip, la bobina se marca.
body.it: Aggiornare una bobina TigerTag+ ora corregge anche marca, materiale, finitura, temperature e colore dal catalogo. Se il chip va riscritto, la bobina viene segnalata.
body.zh: 刷新 TigerTag+ 线轴现在还会从目录更正其品牌、材料、外观、温度和颜色。若芯片需要重写，该线轴会被标记。
body.pt: Atualizar uma bobina TigerTag+ agora também corrige a marca, material, acabamento, temperaturas e cor a partir do catálogo. Se o chip precisar de ser regravado, a bobina é sinalizada.
body.pt-pt: Atualizar uma bobina TigerTag+ passa a corrigir também a marca, material, acabamento, temperaturas e cor a partir do catálogo. Se o chip precisar de ser regravado, a bobina é sinalizada.
body.pl: Odświeżenie szpuli TigerTag+ poprawia teraz także markę, materiał, wykończenie, temperatury i kolor z katalogu. Jeśli chip wymaga ponownego zapisu, szpula zostaje oznaczona.

body.en: When a new version is downloading or ready, you'll see it in the notification bell — with a one-click Restart when it's ready.
body.fr: Quand une nouvelle version se télécharge ou est prête, vous la voyez dans la cloche de notifications — avec un bouton Redémarrer en un clic une fois prête.
body.de: Wenn eine neue Version geladen wird oder bereit ist, erscheint sie in der Benachrichtigungsglocke — mit Neustart per Klick, sobald sie bereit ist.
body.es: Cuando una nueva versión se descarga o está lista, la verás en la campana de notificaciones, con un botón Reiniciar de un clic cuando esté lista.
body.it: Quando una nuova versione si scarica o è pronta, la vedi nella campanella delle notifiche — con riavvio in un clic quando è pronta.
body.zh: 当新版本正在下载或已就绪时，你会在通知铃中看到——就绪后可一键重启。
body.pt: Quando uma nova versão está a transferir ou pronta, vê-la no sino de notificações — com Reiniciar num clique quando estiver pronta.
body.pt-pt: Quando uma nova versão está a ser transferida ou pronta, vê-la no sino de notificações — com Reiniciar num clique quando estiver pronta.
body.pl: Gdy nowa wersja się pobiera lub jest gotowa, zobaczysz to w dzwonku powiadomień — z restartem jednym kliknięciem, gdy będzie gotowa.

body.en: The Friends panel has a new "Share link" button — send the link anywhere and your friend just opens it to pre-fill the add-friend request (they still confirm).
body.fr: Le panneau Amis a un nouveau bouton « Partager le lien » — envoyez-le où vous voulez ; votre ami l'ouvre et la demande d'ajout est pré-remplie (il confirme quand même).
body.de: Das Freunde-Panel hat einen neuen Button "Link teilen" — verschicke ihn beliebig; dein Freund öffnet ihn und die Freundschaftsanfrage ist vorausgefüllt (er bestätigt weiterhin selbst).
body.es: El panel de Amigos tiene un nuevo botón "Compartir enlace": envíalo a donde quieras y tu amigo solo tiene que abrirlo para rellenar la solicitud (él confirma).
body.it: Il pannello Amici ha un nuovo pulsante "Condividi link" — invialo dove vuoi; il tuo amico lo apre e la richiesta di amicizia è precompilata (conferma lui).
body.zh: 好友面板新增"分享链接"按钮——随意发送，好友打开后即自动填好添加请求（仍需其确认）。
body.pt: O painel de Amigos tem um novo botão "Partilhar link" — envie-o para onde quiser e o seu amigo só precisa de abri-lo para preencher o pedido (ele confirma).
body.pt-pt: O painel de Amigos tem um novo botão "Partilhar link" — envie-o para onde quiser e o seu amigo só tem de abri-lo para preencher o pedido (ele confirma).
body.pl: Panel Znajomych ma nowy przycisk "Udostępnij link" — wyślij go gdziekolwiek; znajomy otwiera go, a prośba o dodanie jest już wypełniona (i tak potwierdza).

body.en: Friend avatars appear immediately in the add-friend preview, and accepting or dismissing a request or notification now clears it the instant you click.
body.fr: Les avatars d'amis s'affichent immédiatement dans l'aperçu, et accepter ou ignorer une demande ou une notification l'efface dès le clic.
body.de: Freunde-Avatare erscheinen sofort in der Vorschau, und das Annehmen oder Verwerfen einer Anfrage oder Benachrichtigung wirkt jetzt sofort beim Klick.
body.es: Los avatares de amigos aparecen de inmediato en la vista previa, y aceptar o descartar una solicitud o notificación la quita en el instante en que haces clic.
body.it: Gli avatar degli amici compaiono subito nell'anteprima e accettare o ignorare una richiesta o notifica la rimuove all'istante.
body.zh: 好友头像在预览中立即显示，接受或忽略请求/通知时点击即刻清除。
body.pt: Os avatares de amigos aparecem imediatamente na pré-visualização, e aceitar ou dispensar um pedido ou notificação remove-o assim que clica.
body.pt-pt: Os avatares de amigos aparecem imediatamente na pré-visualização e aceitar ou dispensar um pedido ou notificação remove-o assim que clica.
body.pl: Awatary znajomych pojawiają się od razu w podglądzie, a akceptacja lub odrzucenie prośby czy powiadomienia działa natychmiast po kliknięciu.

title.pt: Creality: controlos da máquina ao vivo
title.pt-pt: Creality: controlos da máquina ao vivo

body.en: Drive your Creality from the side panel — set nozzle, bed and chamber temperatures, jog and home the axes, disable the motors, and control the fans. The motion pad hides during a print to keep jobs safe.
body.fr: Pilotez votre Creality depuis le panneau latéral — réglez les températures buse, plateau et caisson, déplacez et orientez les axes, désactivez les moteurs et gérez les ventilateurs. Le pavé de mouvement se masque pendant une impression pour la protéger.
body.de: Steuere deine Creality über das Seitenpanel — Düsen-, Bett- und Kammertemperatur einstellen, Achsen verfahren und referenzieren, Motoren deaktivieren und Lüfter regeln. Das Bewegungsfeld wird während eines Drucks ausgeblendet.
body.es: Controla tu Creality desde el panel lateral: ajusta las temperaturas de boquilla, cama y cámara, mueve y haz home de los ejes, desactiva los motores y controla los ventiladores. El panel de movimiento se oculta durante una impresión.
body.it: Pilota la tua Creality dal pannello laterale — imposta le temperature di ugello, piano e camera, muovi e azzera gli assi, disattiva i motori e gestisci le ventole. Il pad di movimento si nasconde durante una stampa.
body.zh: 在侧面板直接操控 Creality——设置喷嘴、热床和腔室温度，移动和归零各轴，关闭电机并控制风扇。打印期间隐藏移动面板以保护作业。
body.pt: Comande a sua Creality pelo painel lateral — defina temperaturas de bico, mesa e câmara, mova e faça home dos eixos, desative os motores e controle as ventoinhas. O painel de movimento oculta-se durante uma impressão.
body.pt-pt: Comande a sua Creality pelo painel lateral — defina temperaturas de bico, base e câmara, mova e faça home dos eixos, desative os motores e controle as ventoinhas. O painel de movimento esconde-se durante uma impressão.
body.pl: Steruj Creality z panelu bocznego — ustaw temperatury dyszy, stołu i komory, przesuwaj i bazuj osie, wyłącz silniki i steruj wentylatorami. Panel ruchu chowa się podczas druku.

title.fr: Creality : slots de filament et CFS
title.es: Creality: ranuras de filamento y CFS
title.pt: Creality: ranhuras de filamento e CFS
title.pt-pt: Creality: ranhuras de filamento e CFS

body.en: Pick a filament slot to feed or unload it through the CFS (auto heat, cut and feed). Slots show identified, loaded and empty states, and RFID-identified slots are locked against accidental edits.
body.fr: Sélectionnez un slot de filament pour le charger ou le décharger via le CFS (chauffe, coupe et charge automatiques). Les slots affichent les états identifié, chargé et vide, et les slots identifiés par RFID sont verrouillés contre les modifications accidentelles.
body.de: Wähle einen Filament-Slot, um ihn über das CFS zu laden oder zu entladen (automatisch heizen, schneiden, fördern). Slots zeigen die Zustände erkannt, geladen und leer; RFID-erkannte Slots sind gegen versehentliche Änderungen gesperrt.
body.es: Selecciona una ranura de filamento para cargarla o descargarla por el CFS (calienta, corta y alimenta solo). Las ranuras muestran los estados identificada, cargada y vacía, y las identificadas por RFID quedan bloqueadas ante ediciones accidentales.
body.it: Seleziona uno slot filamento per caricarlo o scaricarlo tramite il CFS (riscalda, taglia e alimenta in automatico). Gli slot mostrano gli stati identificato, caricato e vuoto; quelli identificati via RFID sono bloccati da modifiche accidentali.
body.zh: 选择一个料槽，通过 CFS 进料或退料（自动加热、剪切、送料）。料槽显示已识别、已装载和空三种状态，RFID 识别的料槽锁定以防误改。
body.pt: Selecione uma ranhura de filamento para carregar ou descarregar pelo CFS (aquece, corta e alimenta automaticamente). As ranhuras mostram os estados identificada, carregada e vazia, e as identificadas por RFID ficam bloqueadas contra edições acidentais.
body.pt-pt: Selecione uma ranhura de filamento para carregar ou descarregar pelo CFS (aquece, corta e alimenta automaticamente). As ranhuras mostram os estados identificada, carregada e vazia, e as identificadas por RFID ficam bloqueadas contra edições acidentais.
body.pl: Wybierz slot filamentu, aby załadować go lub wysunąć przez CFS (automatyczne grzanie, cięcie i podawanie). Sloty pokazują stany: zidentyfikowany, załadowany i pusty, a sloty rozpoznane przez RFID są zablokowane przed przypadkową edycją.

body.en: A new bell in the sidebar (with an unread badge) gathers your incoming friend requests and updates in one place. Friend requests shown there are actionable — Accept / Decline / Block — and stay until you choose one, so a request is never…

title.en: Friend requests are easier to handle

body.en: Pending requests now also appear in the Friends panel and the notification center (not just the popup), each showing the requester's real avatar with Accept / Decline / Block.
Accepting or removing a friend now appears instantly for both people without reopening the panel, and a friend's avatar / name / colour changes show up live too.
now shows your number of friends (or a "+" when you have none) instead of the pending-request count — requests moved to the bell.

: added a close () button to dismiss it for later (the request stays pending and can be handled from the bell or Friends panel), and it now shows the requester's real avatar immediately — no initials flash.

The Anycubic printer panel now has a Files button that opens a browser for the printer's stored files. Browse on-printer storage and a USB stick (the USB tab appears once a stick is detected), and — for cloud-connected printers — a Cloud…
The printer list, grid, and the "add a printer" picker now show each manufacturer's logo (Bambu Lab, Anycubic, Creality, Elegoo, FlashForge, Snapmaker).

A printer's online/offline state is now a small coloured dot next to its name — pulsing green when online, flat grey when offline — in both the grid and the side panel. The old "Online / Offline" badge has been removed as redundant.
The printers list and grid now show when each printer was last seen online ("just now" while connected, otherwise how long ago), and it's remembered across restarts.
The filament and printer tables now keep your last sort column and direction across restarts. By default filaments sort by Brand and printers by status (online first).
The printers table now has the same rounded, scrollable finish — with a pinned header — as the filament table.

The FlashForge side panel now shows per-nozzle temperatures (tool-changers like the Creator 5 Pro list each tool T1…Tn with the active one highlighted; single-nozzle models show E1), plus bed and — on enclosed models — chamber, each as…

title.en: FlashForge Creator 5 / 5 Pro: official colour palette

body.en: Setting a filament slot's colour now offers only the printer's 24 built-in "Color Library" swatches — the firmware silently rejects anything else (the slot reverts to white) — so every pick is one the printer actually keeps. Other models…

Printers with two heads (H2C / H2D / X2D) now show both nozzles — tagged R (right) and L (left), with the active head highlighted — each with its own temperature you can tap to set, instead of only the active head.

title.en: Filament colour/material editor no longer opens hidden behind the printer panel

body.en: A recent layering change had pushed the printer side-panel above the edit sheet; the sheet now sits above it again. Affects all brands (Snapmaker / Creality / Elegoo / FlashForge).

title.en: FlashForge temperatures and fans are read-only

body.en: — the firmware doesn't expose a command to set them, so they're shown for monitoring only.

The cloud (Agora) camera shows in the camera wall and the detached camera window too, not just the printer's side panel, and it keeps streaming through long sessions (automatic RTC-token refresh). Thanks to @ennisj (PR #4).

On models with an actively heated chamber (X1E, the H2 series, X2D), the chamber temperature is now a setpoint you can tap to set — like the nozzle and bed. Passive-chamber models (X1C) stay read-only.

title.en: Bambu Lab AMS humidity & temperature now show for every AMS unit

body.en: Machines with more than one AMS (e.g. the H2C, which has two) previously showed nothing; each unit's real humidity % and temperature now appear (labelled A / B / … when there are several). AMS Lite has no sensor and stays blank.
Printers connected in cloud mode now show their live camera in the side panel (an Agora WebRTC stream), not just LAN-connected printers. Thanks to @ennisj (PR #3).

title.en: Adding a printer opens its panel automatically

body.en: Once you finish adding a printer, its side-card now opens straight away instead of leaving you on the list.

title.en: Closing a printer also closes its settings

body.en: If a printer's Settings form was open, closing the printer now closes that form too — no leftover panel floating on the side.

title.en: Settings close tab no longer hidden

body.en: With a spool card, a printer's Settings, and a printer panel all open side by side, the spool card painted over the Settings panel's close tab — the tab is now always reachable.

title.en: Bambu Lab: full machine controls in the printer panel

body.en: The Bambu side-card now has the same live controls as the other brands — pause / resume / stop the current print, jog the X/Y/Z axes, home any axis, toggle the chamber light, disable the motors, set nozzle and bed target temperatures…

Both models are now recognised. Network discovery and "Add by IP" read the printer's serial number automatically, and the exact model is detected on first connection so the correct name and picture appear without picking them by hand. The…

title.en: Bambu Lab: smoother, flicker-free live cards

body.en: The printer card no longer rebuilds itself every time the printer sends an update — only the values that actually changed are refreshed. Editing a field (temperature, a dropdown…) is no longer interrupted when new data arrives, and the…

title.en: Printer settings open beside the printer card

body.en: Opening a printer's settings (gear) now slides the form in next to the printer panel instead of hidden behind it, without dimming the rest of the app, and it has the same » close tab as the other side-cards. Switching to another printer…

title.en: Bambu Lab: correct AMS humidity & temperature

body.en: The A1's AMS Lite has no humidity/temperature sensor, so it no longer shows made-up values. On AMS units that do have a sensor (AMS HT, AMS 2 Pro), humidity now shows the real percentage instead of the internal 1–5 dryness grade, and the…

title.en: FlashForge: newer models are no longer dropped during discovery

body.en: Printers that don't reveal their identity to the first probe (e.g. Creator 5) now appear in the scan and can be set up via "Add by IP".

title.en: Spool and printer side-cards no longer dim the screen

body.en: Opening a spool's or printer's detail card used to drop a dark overlay behind it that you had to dismiss first. Now the list stays fully usable — click another spool or printer and the card switches in place, no close-then-reselect. Each…

title.en: Spool and printer cards can now sit side by side

body.en: Open a spool's card and a printer's card at the same time and the printer keeps the right edge while the spool card tucks in just to its left (passing neatly behind it), instead of one replacing the other — groundwork for dragging a spool…

title.en: Buttons no longer jump down when clicked

body.en: Some buttons — most visibly the show/hide-password eye — shifted downward on press. Fixed everywhere.

title.en: Spool card's close tab now slides behind the printer card

body.en: When both cards were open and you closed the spool card, its orange » tab briefly swept in front of the printer card instead of behind it like the card itself. Fixed.

title.en: Anycubic Kobra X: live camera now works (LAN)

body.en: The Kobra X's camera is now supported over the local network, reusing the same video pipeline as the Kobra 3 V2 — it was previously left off because the Kobra X advertises its stream differently. Thanks to @ennisj (PR #2).

When the printer refuses a command (for example "Home the axis before moving" if you jog before homing), an alert now pops up with the printer's message and error code, so you know why nothing happened.

title.en: Anycubic (cloud): the fan, temperatures and speed mode now work at any time

body.en: — not only while a print is running. They were previously sent in a way the printer only applied to an active job, so at idle nothing happened. They now use the same realtime channel as the official slicer.

title.en: Anycubic (cloud): the light now turns on the right LED

body.en: It was toggling the camera light (which the printer rejects); it now controls the chamber/part light.

title.en: Anycubic: editing a nozzle/bed temperature is fixed

body.en: The input no longer errors out, and clicking away now applies the value (Escape still cancels).

title.en: Bambu Lab: adding a printer by IP now works reliably

body.en: Typing your printer's IP could fail with "No reply from …" even when the printer was online and reachable — the check gave up too quickly before the printer finished answering. It now waits long enough, and it also fills in the serial…

title.en: Bambu Lab camera is smoother and more responsive

body.en: on RTSP models (X1C, X1E, P2S, H2x…). The live view now runs at 30 fps instead of 5 and starts almost instantly — the several-second delay before the first image is gone.

title.en: Bambu Lab camera no longer gets stuck on a black screen / spinner

body.en: on A1, A1 Mini, P1P and P1S. It now reconnects on its own after a printer reboot, a Wi-Fi drop or a slow start, and gives up quickly (a few seconds instead of up to a minute) when the camera port is blocked or unreachable.

title.en: Bambu Lab: the camera stays off when you disable it on the printer

body.en: If you turn the LAN camera off from the printer's own screen, the app no longer keeps trying to open it.

title.en: Anycubic: setting a nozzle or bed temperature no longer closes the input

body.en: The value field used to close every time the printer sent a status update; it now stays open while you type.

title.en: Anycubic (cloud): the job preview thumbnail no longer flickers

body.en: It no longer reloads on every refresh — the preview stays steady.

title.en: Printer Table view: print progress, status and "Updated" now refresh live

body.en: The table used to stay frozen until you clicked Refresh; each row now updates on its own (progress %, remaining time, online status). Affects Bambu Lab, Creality, FlashForge and Snapmaker.

title.en: Anycubic control panel now works in cloud mode too

body.en: Homing, jogging, disabling the motors, the light, nozzle/bed temperatures, the fan, the speed mode and pause/resume/stop now reach cloud-connected printers (they previously only worked over the local network). Temperature, fan, speed and…

title.en: Anycubic: editing a filament slot no longer flickers

body.en: When changing a slot's material or colour, the square briefly flashed back to the old value before settling on the new one. It now switches once, cleanly.

title.en: Anycubic cloud mode now works everywhere — including macOS and Linux

body.en: Adding a cloud printer used to need a Windows-only trick (running the slicer in a special debug mode); now you just click Sign in to Anycubic Cloud, log in on Anycubic's own page in a pop-up window, and your cloud printers appear. Once…

title.en: Anycubic (cloud): no longer stuck on "Idle" at the start of a print

body.en: While the printer was auto-levelling before the first layer, the card wrongly showed "Idle"; it now shows "Preparing" until printing begins.

— the 6th brand, alongside Bambu Lab, Creality, Elegoo, FlashForge and Snapmaker. Connect over your local network or through Anycubic's cloud (a mixed fleet works in one list), see the ACE multi-colour box and its slots, set a slot's…

— drive a connected Anycubic printer straight from its side card, like Snapmaker and Elegoo: home the axes (XYZ / XY / Z) or disable the motors to move them by hand, jog X/Y/Z by 1 / 10 / 50 mm, set the nozzle and bed targets, toggle the…

Each ACE slot now reflects its real state: a present spool keeps its colour, while an empty (not-mounted) slot shows a grey “?” with the colour kept as an outline so it stays recognisable, and the material name still shows underneath. From…

title.en: Bambu Lab camera: smoother, lower-latency video

body.en: The camera stream now carries frames as raw binary instead of Base64 text — that removes image-encoding work from the app's main thread (which also handles the printer connection) and shrinks the data passed around internally, so the…

title.en: Locked storage slots now have two clear states

body.en: Locking an *empty* slot marks it as unusable — it gets a grey hatched look and is removed from the rack's available capacity (so 130/198 becomes 130/197). Locking a *filled* slot pins the material in place — it keeps the spool's colour…

Camera frames are now coalesced to one repaint per frame instead of piling up when the app is busy, which removes the stutter bursts on the printer camera view (P2S, H2C, X1 and the rest of the RTSP range, plus the JPEG models).
in the container picker: Anycubic masterspool (Black, 218 g) and DEEPLEE cardboard spool (Standard, 143 g).

anonymous usage statistics now track spool-lifecycle counts over time (how many TigerData / TigerTag / TigerTag+ spools are created, and conversions between them). No personal data, no IP geolocation — same privacy-preserving, aggregate…

title.en: Encoding a custom or third-party spool no longer resets it on the next scan

body.en: When you wrote a tag for a custom spool — or a spool from another manufacturer — and then read it again, the spool reverted to the generic cardboard container and its weight changed back to the value stored on the chip. The app now keeps…

title.en: The app now opens already populated — like Discord or Slack

body.en: On launch, your inventory, your friends and your avatar appear in the very first frame, painted instantly from the previous session's local cache; the live data from the server then merges on top silently, repainting only what actually…

A small TigerTag splash with the logo and the app version shows the instant you open the app, and the main window only appears once it's ready to display fully — no more watching the interface assemble itself piece by piece.

title.en: Your sidebar friends list now scrolls

body.en: when you have more friends than fit on screen, with no visible scrollbar (Discord-style). The avatar, the Refresh / Friends buttons and the community footer stay fixed in place.

title.en: No more flickering avatars on launch

body.en: Your avatar in the inventory header and your friends' avatars in the sidebar used to flash / reload 2–3 times on every cold start. They now paint once and stay put.

title.en: No more "loading shine" sweeping across every image

body.en: A shimmer animation used to glide left-to-right over every image while it loaded (avatars, inventory, printers). Since images now load instantly from the local cache, that effect was removed — images simply appear.

title.en: Your initials can no longer show behind or beside your avatar photo,

body.en: and the "+" sign-in badge can no longer leak next to your initials. The avatar now always shows exactly one of: the "+" (signed out), your initials (no photo), or your photo — never a mix.

title.en: No more flicker on app open — your avatar (and your friends' avatars) now appear in the very first frame

body.en: Previously the sidebar avatar went through "empty circle wrong letter from your email real letter from your name photo" on every cold start, and the friends list in the sidebar dropdown showed up empty until Firestore round-tripped. Now…

title.en: No more "B" or random wrong letter in your avatar circle

body.en: Before this fix, until Firestore loaded your display name, the avatar fell back to the first letter of your email address — so for benoit@… the sidebar briefly showed a "B" in your colour, then jumped to your real "OM" (or whatever your…

title.en: No more Google placeholder photo overwriting your custom avatar

body.en: A long-standing bug was overwriting your uploaded avatar with Google's auto-generated profile picture (the "letter on coloured circle" you see when a Google account has no photo) on every sign-in. If you saw a stranger letter / colour…

title.en: No more "+" badge bleeding next to your initials

body.en: A CSS specificity bug was causing the "sign in" plus-icon to show next to your initials in the sidebar avatar when you were already signed in.

title.en: Avatar upload on Windows 10 now opens the crop modal reliably

body.en: A race between the file-picker's focus and change events on Windows 10's I/O scheduler was silently resolving the picker with no file, so the crop modal never opened and the upload silently failed. Switched to the modern cancel event for…

All eight places in the UI that show a coloured-circle avatar (sidebar, the "OM" header chip, dropdown, profile-management modal, edit-account modal, sidebar friend chips, friends panel, friend-view header) now go through a single…

title.en: Custom profile picture — upload your own avatar

body.en: The colour-circle + initials avatar everywhere in Studio (sidebar, top "OM" header chip, edit-account modal, account dropdown, profiles modal, friends list, friends panel, friend banner when previewing a friend's inventory) now shows your…

title.en: No more flashes or disappearing grid on the built-in Retina display

body.en: On a MacBook's built-in Retina screen in full-screen, opening a spool side card used to make the grid flicker, lose its cards, or leave the side card as a blank rectangle — every interaction in the inventory area would trigger another wave…

title.en: Open the connection tutorial straight from the printer settings

body.en: The pencil/configure panel for a Bambu Lab, FlashForge or Elegoo printer now has a " Tutoriel de connexion" button at the top — for the moment you realise you skipped the tutorial during the scan and still need to find the access code or…

title.en: Scan results show the printer photo

body.en: A FlashForge tile in the scan results now shows the printer's product photo on the left, like the mobile app — easier to recognise your AD5X vs your 5M Pro at a glance.

title.en: One shared "extra subnets" list across every brand, synced to your account

body.en: The Power-user "Autres réseaux à scanner" widget that appeared inside Snapmaker, Creality, Elegoo and FlashForge now also appears in Bambu Lab, and the list is the same one everywhere — declared once, honoured by every scan. The list is…

title.en: FlashForge LAN scan finds printers on routed subnets again

body.en: If your FlashForge sits on a different /24 than your Mac (typical multi-VLAN home network), Studio now finds it the same way the mobile app does. Three small fixes stack: the probe now talks to the printer's TCP ~M115 identity endpoint as…

title.en: Connection tutorial in the printer settings now follows the selected model

body.en: Was always opening the same tutorial regardless of the model dropdown — most visible on Bambu Lab where 11 models share 3 different tutorials.

title.en: Printer connection tutorials, brought over from the mobile app

body.en: Connecting a Bambu Lab — LAN-only mode, developer mode, IP + serial + access code — takes seven steps and a lot of context. The mobile app already walked users through it; the desktop app now does too. Open the Add Printer panel, and any…

title.en: Printer table sorts by status by default

body.en: Open the Printers view as Tableau and the connected printers come up first, offline ones at the bottom. Click any column header to sort differently, like before.
Removed the grey rectangle behind the printer photo in the Printers Grille view — the photo now sits directly on the card.

title.en: Auto-update is now more robust against transient GitHub outages

body.en: The app was hitting GitHub with the old project URL (TigerTag_Studio_Manager, with underscores) and relying on GitHub to silently redirect to the canonical URL (TigerTag-Studio-Manager, with hyphens). Every check therefore made two…

title.en: New "Balance" weight input mode for kitchen-scale users

body.en: Open the spool detail panel, click the pencil next to the weight, and a small Net / Balance toggle now sits next to the / buttons. In Balance mode you type the value your scale shows (filament + container); Studio subtracts the container…

title.en: Saving a weight no longer reloads the side panel

body.en: Editing the weight from the slider or the manual input used to flash the product image, the "Mettre à jour le RFID" banner, the TigerTag SVG badges, and every other icon for a fraction of a second because the panel rebuilt itself after…

title.en: The verbose green save toast is gone

body.en: Instead of " N g disponibles (G g − C g contenant) · jumeau mis à jour" sitting under the weight bar for a full second, a small green check now pops to the right of the "POIDS" section title and gently fades out. The new value is already…

title.en: The weight slider waits for you to actually release before saving to the cloud

body.en: Pausing mid-drag for half a second (still holding the slider) used to burn a Firestore write at every pause; now the write only fires once you release the thumb, and re-grabbing the slider within 500 ms cancels the pending request. Fewer…

title.en: If someone else edits the same spool while you're dragging, the server wins

body.en: If your phone — or another logged-in device — updates the weight on the same spool while you have the desktop slider held down, the slider now releases your grip and snaps to the value that just arrived from the cloud (and your pending…

title.en: Container card layout — the container name now sits in the same column as "Customizable" and the weight in grams

body.en: , beside the container thumbnail, instead of sitting on its own line above the card.

title.en: Spool detail side panel no longer flashes when something else changes in Firestore

body.en: Editing a different spool — from the mobile app, from another device, or even just a write echo coming back — used to tear down and rebuild the entire side panel, flashing the product photo and every SVG icon (badges, twin link, chip…

title.en: Cold start is now instant from cache

body.en: Tiger Studio now stores every Firestore snapshot in a local IndexedDB cache, so on the next launch your inventory, racks and printers appear immediately — even before the network round-trip completes — and the app stays usable when…

title.en: Product thumbnails no longer flash on view switches

body.en: Cached product images are now served as proper HTTP responses from the local app server instead of being inlined as base64 data URLs. The browser keeps the decoded bitmap alive across DOM operations, so clicking Grid, opening the detail…

title.en: Filaments Grid and Table views no longer flash when one spool changes

body.en: Editing a single field on a spool — moving the weight slider, picking a container, linking a twin, changing the color — used to flash the whole Filaments view because every card or row was destroyed and rebuilt from scratch on every…

title.en: Printer Grid view: the per-printer job block (state pill, progress bar, filename) stops rebuilding on every brand poll tick when nothing actually changed

body.en: FlashForge polls every 2 seconds, Bambu every 5, Elegoo every 10 — and the job block was being destroyed and re-created on every one of those, even when the printer was idle or offline. Now the block is only touched when state, progress…

title.en: Filaments Grid and Table views no longer flash on every search keystroke

body.en: Typing in the search bar with the Filaments view open (in Grid mode or Table mode) used to flash the whole view at every letter — every spool card or row was destroyed and rebuilt from scratch, and every had to be re-decoded by the…

title.en: Printer Grid view no longer refreshes constantly when printers are offline

body.en: Every printer reconnect retry (every 2 to 30 seconds, per printer) used to rebuild the whole printer grid — every card image was destroyed and re-decoded, producing a visible refresh flash several times per minute on a 10-printer setup…

title.en: Storage view no longer flashes on every search keystroke or rack hover

body.en: Typing in the search bar with the Storage view open used to flash the whole grid at every letter, and sweeping the mouse between racks that both contained search matches produced a visible flash too — most noticeably on large inventories…

title.en: Contextual "+ Add Rack" inside the "Spools not stored" side panel

body.en: When you have more unstored spools than free slots — i.e. you actually need more rack capacity — an orange-accented CTA appears right inside the side panel with a short explanation. Hidden when there's still room to drag spools into…

title.en: "+ Add Rack" moved into the main header

(@pokusew/pcsclite, @serialport/bindings-cpp) correctly signed inside the bundle via entitlementsInherit and cs.disable-library-validation.

title.en: New build:mac:unsigned script for fast local builds without

body.en: New build:mac:unsigned script for fast local builds without Apple credentials.

title.en: Fix — silent login failure on email/password

body.en: sign-in. Auth listener was gated on getActiveId() matching the new uid, but setActiveId() only ran inside the listener. Reordered: setActiveId runs after updateCurrentUser and before setupNamedAuth.

Every caught auth/network error and every window.error / unhandledrejection captured into a circular buffer. Copy a Markdown report from Settings Debug Report a problem — includes app version, Electron/Chrome/Node, OS, locale, account…

title.en: Storage / Rack feature gated off in this build until the vis

body.en: Storage / Rack feature gated off in this build until the visualisation skeleton is finalised.
Hop from one spool (or printer) to the next and the new card slides in over the old one instead of blinking into place. It even opens scrolled neatly to the top.
body.fr: Passez d'une bobine (ou d'une imprimante) à l'autre : la nouvelle fiche glisse par-dessus l'ancienne au lieu de surgir d'un coup. Et elle s'ouvre bien calée en haut.
body.de: Spring von einer Spule (oder einem Drucker) zur nächsten und die neue Karte gleitet über die alte, statt einfach aufzublitzen. Sie öffnet sich sogar sauber ganz oben.
body.es: Salta de una bobina (o impresora) a otra y la nueva ficha se desliza sobre la anterior en vez de aparecer de golpe. Y se abre bien colocada arriba.
body.it: Passa da una bobina (o stampante) all'altra e la nuova scheda scivola sopra la vecchia invece di comparire di colpo. E si apre ben posizionata in alto.
body.zh: 在线材（或打印机）之间切换时，新卡片会滑到旧卡片上方，而不是直接闪出来。打开时还乖乖滚到顶部。
body.pt: Pule de uma bobina (ou impressora) para outra e o novo cartão desliza por cima do anterior em vez de surgir do nada. E abre certinho lá no topo.
body.pt-pt: Salte de uma bobina (ou impressora) para outra e o novo cartão desliza por cima do anterior em vez de surgir do nada. E abre certinho no topo.
body.pl: Przeskocz z jednej szpuli (lub drukarki) na drugą, a nowa karta wsuwa się na starą zamiast nagle wyskakiwać. Otwiera się też ładnie przewinięta na górę.

body.en: Identical spools now group up out of the box. Prefer everything laid out flat? One switch in the settings and you're back to a plain list.
body.fr: Les bobines identiques se regroupent d'office. Vous préférez tout à plat ? Un réglage et vous retrouvez une liste simple.
body.de: Identische Spulen gruppieren sich jetzt von selbst. Lieber alles flach? Ein Schalter in den Einstellungen und du hast wieder eine einfache Liste.
body.es: Las bobinas idénticas ahora se agrupan de serie. ¿Prefieres todo en plano? Un ajuste y vuelves a una lista simple.
body.it: Le bobine identiche ora si raggruppano di serie. Preferisci tutto in piano? Un'opzione e torni a una lista semplice.
body.zh: 一模一样的线材现在默认会分组。想全部平铺？设置里点一下就回到普通列表。
body.pt: Bobinas idênticas agora se agrupam de fábrica. Prefere tudo em lista? Um ajuste e você volta à lista simples.
body.pt-pt: Bobinas idênticas agora agrupam-se de fábrica. Prefere tudo em lista? Um ajuste e volta à lista simples.
body.pl: Identyczne szpule grupują się teraz domyślnie. Wolisz wszystko płasko? Jedno ustawienie i wracasz do zwykłej listy.

body.en: Choosing a container no longer hijacks the screen — it slides in next to your spool, with bigger pictures and each weight on show.
body.fr: Choisir un contenant ne prend plus tout l'écran — ça s'ouvre à côté de votre bobine, avec de plus grandes images et chaque poids affiché.
body.de: Einen Behälter zu wählen kapert nicht mehr den Bildschirm — er gleitet neben deine Spule, mit größeren Bildern und sichtbarem Gewicht.
body.es: Elegir un contenedor ya no acapara la pantalla — se abre junto a tu bobina, con imágenes más grandes y cada peso a la vista.
body.it: Scegliere un contenitore non si prende più tutto lo schermo — si apre accanto alla bobina, con immagini più grandi e ogni peso in vista.
body.zh: 选容器不再霸占整个屏幕——它会开在线材旁边，图更大，每个重量也都看得见。
body.pt: Escolher um recipiente não toma mais a tela inteira — ele abre ao lado da bobina, com imagens maiores e cada peso à mostra.
body.pt-pt: Escolher um recipiente já não toma o ecrã inteiro — abre ao lado da bobina, com imagens maiores e cada peso à mostra.
body.pl: Wybór pojemnika nie zajmuje już całego ekranu — otwiera się obok szpuli, z większymi obrazkami i widoczną wagą.

body.en: Cleaner buttons, calmer hovers, and the inventory refresh now sits quietly where it belongs. Nothing dramatic — just nicer.
body.fr: Boutons plus propres, survols plus calmes, et le rafraîchissement de l'inventaire se range discrètement là où il faut. Rien de spectaculaire — juste plus agréable.
body.de: Sauberere Buttons, ruhigere Hover, und das Inventar-Aktualisieren sitzt jetzt still an seinem Platz. Nichts Dramatisches — einfach schöner.
